name: Premium SUV
models: Toyota Prado, Land Cruiser or similar
short: Higher, roomier and calmer on the hill roads. Our choice for VIP guests.
summary: A larger, higher vehicle for the hill-country bends and for guests who should arrive rested: honeymooners, families of four, wedding VIPs.

features.title: Built for the climbs
features.body: Four-wheel drive and a high seat make the roads up to Nuwara Eliya and Ella smoother, and the views better.

features.title: Room for real luggage
features.body: Four large cases fit behind the rear seats, so nothing rides on your lap.

features.title: A quieter arrival
features.body: The vehicle we send for wedding couples, their families and anyone who should arrive looking as if they have not travelled at all.

included: Driver's meals and rooms on multi-day hires

questions.q: Can the SUV take us into a national park?
questions.a: Not on the game drive itself. The parks only allow registered safari jeeps on their tracks, so we book a jeep for the drive and your SUV waits at the gate.

questions.q: Is it worth the difference over a car?
questions.a: On a hill-country route or with four people, usually yes. On a coast-only trip for two, the comfort car does the job.
